# strategy — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Limit-order strategy trading on Agentic Wallet (create-limit / cancel / list / resume). Required flags are in the signature; `ocl strategy <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### strategy create-limit
Place a price-triggered limit order
`ocl strategy create-limit --chain-id <CHAIN_ID> --from-token <FROM_TOKEN> --to-token <TO_TOKEN> --amount <AMOUNT> --trigger-price <TRIGGER_PRICE> --direction <DIRECTION> [options]`
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance in percent (e.g. `20` or `20%` → wire `"0.20"`)
- `--mev-protection <MEV_PROTECTION>` — MEV protection: `on` / `off` / `default` (BE picks) (default default; on|off|default)
- `--current-price <CURRENT_PRICE>` — Current USD price of the comparison token (to-token for `buy`, from-token for `sell`)
- `--wait` — Wait for order terminal state after submission

### strategy cancel
Cancel a single / batch / all active limit orders
`ocl strategy cancel [options]`
- `--order-id <ORDER_ID>` — Cancel a single order by id
- `--order-ids <ORDER_IDS>` — Cancel a batch — comma-separated order ids
- `--all` — Cancel every active order on the active account
- `--wait` — Wait for order terminal state after submission

### strategy list
List open or specific limit orders
`ocl strategy list [options]`
- `--order-id <ORDER_ID>` — Get a single order's full detail (uses GET openOrderDetail)
- `--status <STATUS>` — Comma-separated statuses (`active,suspended,creating,...`) or integer values
- `--chain-id <CHAIN_ID>` — Comma-separated chain ids (e.g. `1,501`)
- `--token <TOKEN>` — Single token address to filter on
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size (BE default 100, max 100)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor — pass the previous response's `nextCursor`
- `--strategy-mode <STRATEGY_MODE>` — Strategy mode for openOrderDetail (default 7 = U-pegged Phase 1) (default 7)

### strategy resume
Re-activate suspended orders (auto-discover or by id)
`ocl strategy resume [options]`
- `--order-ids <ORDER_IDS>` — Comma-separated order ids to resume
- `--wait` — Wait for order terminal state after submission
